<thought>From the spectrum, the M+2 peak (m/z 278) is about one‑third the intensity of the monoisotopic peak, a characteristic pattern of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl ≈ 3:1). No other distinctive isotopic spacings (e.g., Br’s ~1:1 M+2) are evident, so chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
